test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer '**wajes**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is '**wajes**'. Its correct spelling is '**wages**'. • **Wages**: the regular amount of money that you earn for a week’s work. [वेतन, मज़दूरी (काम करने के लिए प्राप्‍त नियमित धनराशि)] • *Example: minimum **wage** [the lowest wage that an employer is allowed to pay by law]...* **​Correct Answer:__** *wajes.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Refusal**: saying or showing that you will not do, give or accept something. [(किसी बात को मानने, काम को करने से) इनकार करने की क्रिया; इनकार] • **Stretch**: to pull something so that it becomes longer or wider; to become longer or wider in this way. (किसी वस्‍तु को अधिक लंबा या चौड़ा करने के लिए खींचना; (किसी वस्‍तु का) खिंच कर अधिक लंबा या चौड़ा हो जाना, बढ़ जाना, तनन) • **Wearily**: with extreme tiredness. (बहुत थक कर) 13f:T7bc, The correct answer is **'it will rain'.**
